risk_if_not_implemented: Without Software Development Repository, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to manage separate development, testing and operational environments to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational environment and to ensure no impact to production Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments (TDA-15.1) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of Software Development Repository (CFG-17.3) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Prohibition Of Changes
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to prohibit unauthorized changes, unless approved through the organization's defined change management processes.
compensating_control_2.justification: Prohibition Of Changes (CHG-04) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Software Development Repository (CFG-17.3) by restricting system and data access through alternative identity and access management mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
